lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 5 minutes, when the opponent shows a ground posture with Siege Tanks and Marauders, and you have Marines and a heavy economy.
lessons.why: Siege Tanks provide strong defensive and offensive capabilities against ground armies, especially in TvT.

lessons.why: A balanced army is versatile and can adapt to various opponent compositions. Heavy economy supports continued production.
